name: lotte-world-tower
description: Convex tapered rounded-square glass envelope,narrow vertical seams,two separated crown ears and a connecting sky bridge above the roof cleft.
attribution: Original Low Poly Earth geometry; mapped placement and source rings © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via Protomaps.

audit.published_controls: KPF rounded555m and split crown ears with sky bridge;CTBUH554.5m. Retained mapped section rings constrain the lower and upper taper.
audit.estimates: Intermediate section levels are mapped building-part approximations,not survey elevations. Crown cleft width,541m bridge datum and rib spacing are estimated;large adjoining Lotte World Mall remains native.
audit.ground_method: Fixed entrance level estimated from retained non-bridge mapped street controls and footprint samples. Street samples are not independent survey benchmarks; DSM roof/tunnel contamination is explicitly excluded. In-engine approach review remains required.
audit.terrain_ownership: Grades are confined to modeled ground footprints with7.5m transition;fixed architecture datum is independent of those grades. Below-ground foundation depth includes0.6m burial beneath the lowest retained perimeter sample.
audit.engine_review: Pending actual engine overview and low-angle entrance/support inspection.

geometry: original metric geometry authored for Low Poly Earth from cited architectural references
